hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes amounts using its own AMM formula, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the native pool AMM. Swaps revert if dParams.expiration has passed. Native liquidity positions and donations are blocked.
